sections.title: Qué vas a aprender a decir

blocks.text: Hasta ahora hablabas de lo que es ahora: I am at home. Ahora vas a contar lo que fue: «ayer estaba en casa», «en Navidad estuvimos juntos», «en la bolsa había dos pinzas». Para eso la pieza tiene una forma pasada.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
We were together at Christmas.
There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
examples.translation: En la bolsa había dos pinzas.

examples.en: Was it warm in spring?

blocks.text: La pieza tiene dos formas pasadas. Donde iba am o is, ahora va was: I was, she was, it was. Donde iba are, ahora were: you were, we were, they were. Sirven para «era», «estaba», «fue», «estuvo»: en inglés no hay que elegir. Y siempre con quién al principio.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
She was in London last year.
examples.translation: El año pasado estuvo en Londres.

examples.en: We were at home last night.
They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: En Año Nuevo estaban en Londres.

examples.en: The hairdresser was busy yesterday.

fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.
I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

sections.title: Marcas del pasado: yesterday, last night, on Sunday

blocks.text: Casi siempre hay una palabra que marca el pasado: yesterday — «ayer», last night — «anoche», last year — «el año pasado». Para fiestas, at: at Christmas, at New Year. Para días, on: on Sunday — sin «the».

examples.en: I was at home on Sunday.
We were together at Christmas.
They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: En Año Nuevo estaban en Londres.

examples.en: The sports centre was closed yesterday.

fixes.right: We were together at Christmas.

fixes.wrong: I was at home the Sunday.
fixes.right: I was at home on Sunday.

blocks.text: Si hablas de ayer, was o were. Si hablas de ahora, is o are, como antes. La palabra yesterday o now ya te lo dice: Yesterday my towel was wet. The shower curtain is dry now.

examples.en: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.
examples.translation: Ayer mi toalla de playa estaba mojada.

examples.en: Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.
The shower curtain is dry now.
examples.translation: Ahora la cortina de la regadera está seca.

examples.en: The bathroom mirror was dirty yesterday.
examples.translation: Ayer el espejo del baño estaba sucio.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.
Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.

drill.question: Ayer la toalla estaba mojada. ¿Cómo lo dices?
drill.optionA: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
drill.optionB: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

sections.title: Lo que no se cuenta por piezas — was

blocks.text: Como en la lección 4, lo que no se cuenta por piezas — crema, comida, jugo — va con la forma de uno: was, no were. Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

examples.en: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.
examples.translation: Ayer el bloqueador estaba en mi bolsa.

examples.en: The apple juice was cold yesterday.
examples.translation: Ayer el jugo de manzana estaba frío.

examples.en: The hot chocolate was too sweet yesterday.
examples.translation: Ayer el chocolate caliente estaba demasiado dulce.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday the sun cream were in my bag.
fixes.right: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

fixes.wrong: The baby food were in the cupboard.
fixes.right: The baby food was in the cupboard.

blocks.text: En español «no» va delante: «no estaba». En inglés not va después de la pieza: It was not my day off. The fried egg was not cold. Para varios, were not.

examples.en: It was not my day off.
The fried egg was not cold.
examples.translation: El huevo frito no estaba frío.

examples.en: The peanut butter was not on the table.
examples.translation: La crema de cacahuate no estaba en la mesa.

fixes.wrong: It no was my day off.
fixes.right: It was not my day off.
The fried egg was not cold.

blocks.text: La pregunta se arma como en la lección 2: la pieza delante. Was it warm in spring? Were you at home in autumn? La respuesta corta también con la pieza: Yes, it was. No, it was not. Aquí no van do ni did.

examples.en: Was it warm in spring?
Were you at home in autumn?
Was your pancake hot?
Were the scrambled eggs hot?
Yes, it was.

fixes.right: Was it warm in spring?
Was your pancake hot?
Yes, it was.

blocks.text: En español «había» sirve para uno y para muchos. En inglés no: There was para una cosa, There were para varias. There was a towel rail in the bathroom. There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

examples.en: There was a bed sheet on the bed.
examples.translation: En la cama había una sábana.

examples.en: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
examples.translation: En la bolsa había dos pinzas.

examples.en: There was a public toilet near the station.
examples.translation: Cerca de la estación había un baño público.

examples.en: There were two taxi drivers near the station.
examples.translation: Cerca de la estación había dos taxistas.

examples.en: There was fruit salad in the bowl.
examples.translation: En el tazón había ensalada de frutas.

fixes.wrong: There was two clothes pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

fixes.wrong: Had two clothes pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

drill.after: two duvet covers in the cupboard.
drill.why: Son dos fundas, así que There were.

blocks.text: Con was es fácil opinar sobre algo pasado: That was a silly idea — «fue una idea tonta», The plan was sensible — «el plan era sensato». Para varias cosas, were: The rules were fair.

examples.en: That was a silly idea.
The plan was sensible.
The rules were fair.

sections.title: Los errores que comete casi todo el mundo

fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

fixes.wrong: There was two clothes pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
Was it warm in spring?
Yes, it was.
We were together at Christmas.

blocks.text: Toda la gramática nueva son dos formas: was para I, he, she, it y una cosa; were para you, we, they y varias. Lo demás, igual que con am, is, are.
Fue, estaba: was o were, siempre con quién. No estaba: was not, were not. Pregunta: Was…? Were…?, respuesta: Yes, it was. Había: There was / There were. Ayer: was; ahora: is.

examples.en: She was in London last year.
examples.translation: El año pasado estuvo en Londres.

examples.en: It was not my day off.
Were you at home in autumn?
There was a soap dish next to the washbasin.
examples.translation: Junto al lavabo había una jabonera.
